description: Fetch an SEC filing's primary document (HTML converted to clean text, tables preserved as aligned rows). Identify it by `url` (any www.sec.gov/Archives document URL from list_filings) or by `company` + `accession`. Optionally extract one 10-K/10-Q item via `section` (e.g. '1' Business, '1A' Risk Factors, '7' MD&A, '7A' Market Risk, '8' Financial Statements; for 10-Q: '1' Financial Statements, '2' MD&A, '1A' Risk Factors). Long text is paged: use max_chars and the returned next_offset.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

name: get_filing_document
title: Read a filing document
